name: HOZO claims origin-group isolation and LIFF OAuth recovery
type: HOZO claims security and routing hotfix
requiresDatabases: Existing AM Platform PostgreSQL claims authority database
requiresEnv: Existing HZ2_FINANCE_CLAIMS_V3_RECIPIENT_BINDINGS_JSON for direct V3 group delivery
dependencies: AM-IMP-2026.0914.01 HOZO claims group-to-form publishing and chooser

dataIsolation.guard: Published selector replies use only the current LINE event reply token or its exact raw origin group; direct V3 queue delivery requires the origin group's own opaque recipient reference.

definitionOfDone: A claim chooser is delivered only to the exact LINE group that originated the command
Cross-group fallback is impossible when an origin group has no exact Finance scope
Existing incorrect stored group binding is reconciled from live routing on the next claim command
Selector token survives external-browser LINE OAuth only through a short-lived secure cookie
Legacy and V3 form selection remain applicant-bound and server-revalidated
Synthetic checks, package validation and production verification pass
